description: Log a business mileage trip in ExpenseBot. Useful for realtors, consultants, contractors, and anyone who drives for work. Requires the user to have configured their mileage rate (cents/km or cents/mi) and unit (mi/km) in ExpenseBot Settings. The trip writes a row to their expense spreadsheet with the calculated dollar value. Use the Mileage and travel link from get_spreadsheet_url instead when the user needs Google Maps route calculation, mileage settings, repeated trips, calendar/rideshare import, per diem, or visual review.

category.description: Override the user's default mileage category (optional)

distance.description: Distance traveled in the user's configured unit (miles or km)

notes.description: Optional user-supplied context stored with the mileage entry.

purpose.description: Business purpose / description of the trip (e.g., 'Client meeting at 1234 Main St')

roundTrip.description: If true, doubles the distance (return trip)

name: add_mileage_entry
